replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Hello, Professor!

Thanks for putting a report in. Unfortunately, I'm going to have to deny this report for a couple of reasons.

- The video is not in spectator view. This makes it very hard to tell. 

- CTH is overall hard for detecting hacks, due to the fast hit glitch.

- The bit of lag in the video also makes it hard to tell.

If you collect more evidence, feel free to submit another report. 

Thank you,
Vobaseball12, Avicus Network Moderator & Official.
